_comment: Airfields whose name matches any of these case-insensitive regexes are never offered to an airframe. Syria's map has ~140 generated hospital/stadium/oil helipads that DCS reports as airdromes.
_comment_fixed_wing: Helipads that DCS reports as airdromes (Germany: 'H FRG 40', 'H Med GDR 01', 'H Radar GDR 07'). Left out for fixed-wing aircraft only: helicopters still use them.
